the NA62 GIGA Tracker is a low material hybrid pixel detector that is capable of timing particles with 100 ps resolution.
the GigaTracker has a very low material budget, is easy to operate and is easy to access for maintenance.

The NA62 GIGATRACKER detector is a low material budget hybrid pixel detector with a sensor size 60x27mm(2), consisting of 18000 pixels each 300x300 mu m(3) that is operated in a beam with an intensity of 750 MHz at a temperature of -20 to 00C in vacuum.

the electro-mechanic integration of the GTPixel ASIC is a key element to achieve the desired material budget.
